title: Good intentions for daily actions
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y3 lesson 10 (Pupil PDF worksheet: good intentions for daily actions)
intro: Lesson 10: Actions are by intentions. To understand that Allah rewards our actions according to the intention (niyyah) in our hearts

questions.q: Explain the hadith 'actions are by intentions' in one sentence.
questions.a: Allah rewards us by the reason in our hearts, not just what we do.
questions.model: Point: what matters is why we do it. Evidence: 'Actions are only by intentions' (Bukhari and Muslim). Explain: two people can do the same thing and get different rewards.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, write a good intention for each action: eating, sleeping, studying, helping at home. Start: 'I eat so that ...'
questions.a: For example: I eat so that I am strong to worship Allah; I study to learn and help others
questions.model: Teacher writes: 'I sleep early so that I can wake up for Fajr.'

questions.q: which action could be done for a bad intention? How would you fix it?
questions.a: For example: helping to show off; fix it by doing it for Allah

questions.q: why is it good to keep some good deeds secret?
questions.a: It keeps the intention sincere, for Allah only

questions.q: Back to our ponder: do the two children get the same reward?
